skills.detail:
When You or the Enemy Has a Treasure Area with an Enemy Present:
Moves towards enemies at long-range and attacks multiple times with a Knockback effect.
Also deals a multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect to enemies around your or the enemy's Treasure Areas that have an enemy present (up to 4 spots).
Increases own SPD.

When You and the Enemy Have No Treasure Areas with an Enemy Present:
Moves towards enemies at long-range and attacks multiple times with a Knockback effect.
Increases own SPD.

When dealing damage, your Element will change to the Element you are strong against of either Red Element, Blue Element, or Green Element, just once.
Your Element will not change if attacking a Light or Dark Element enemy.
Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Become temporarily invincible after use.

skills.detail:
When "Acceleration...is power!!!" is used, Skill 2 will transform into the Combo Skill "Speed...is weight" for a set period of time.
Skill 2 turns back into "Acceleration...is power!!!" after a certain amount of time passes.

When You or the Enemy Has a Treasure Area with an Enemy Present:
Moves you to the nearest Treasure Area belonging to your team or the enemy's with an enemy present.
Deals a mid-range multiple hit area attack.

When You and the Enemy Have No Treasure Areas with an Enemy Present:
A mid-range multiple hit area attack.

When dealing damage, your Element will change to the Element you are strong against of either Red Element, Blue Element, or Green Element, just once.
Your Element will not change if attacking a Light or Dark Element enemy.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
